Name: Nyapu Style Nora the Herpetologist Portraits by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Nora the Herpetologist in Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/center][/size][/b]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]
I adore Nyapu's portraits and wanted all of my mod to match that style. I had started work on a couple of Nora portrait retextures a while ago, but I wanted to finish some other projects before this one. I'll be concentrating on custom NPCs for now, before moving on to another major retexture.

[b] 2.0 Update! Added all of Nora's Festival outfits![/b]


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18176] ﻿﻿Nora The Herpetologist [/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. You should get a prompt to replace
the original files if you do it right. If you need more guidance, Nyapu
has a great example on their page. 

NOTE: If you're only using the manual portrait replacement file -- Nora's Winter indoors will not work. ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/165454243]bagibagriela[/url] has yet to code this into the original mod.)
NOTE: If you're only using the manual portrait replacement file -- Only Egg and Flower festivals will work. (I think bagibagrista has not gotten around to programming in the other holidays yet.)

[i][b]ADDED FEATURES:[/b]
The CP version has added Nora's Winter Indoor Portrait and sprite. 
All the festivals bagibagriela created for Nora have been added to the CP file. [/i]
[b]
